capabilities.name: Create model scene
capabilities.description: Create a project-local model scene using the native PL model format.
capabilities.source: Modeling Studio / Project and Scene Management
capabilities.notes: Native .plmodel.json scene creation and persistence are validated.

capabilities.name: Open save and close model scene
capabilities.description: Open, persist, close, and reopen model scenes without data loss.
capabilities.source: Modeling Studio / Project and Scene Management

capabilities.name: Interactive 3D viewport
capabilities.description: Render and navigate an interactive Three.js-backed 3D scene.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.6.1 — Viewport selection modes transforms and precision
capabilities.notes: Stage 4 replaced the earlier viewport stub with a real engine-backed viewport.

capabilities.name: Camera and viewport navigation
capabilities.description: Provide camera orbit, pan, zoom, perspective, orthographic, camera views, overlays, and multi-view layouts.
capabilities.notes: Core camera controls exist; full official-v1 view modes and layout system remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Object and mesh selection modes
capabilities.description: Select objects and support object, edit, vertex, edge, and face selection modes.
capabilities.notes: Object selection exists; full mesh component modes remain missing.

capabilities.name: Object transforms
capabilities.description: Translate, rotate, and scale scene objects through engine-backed transform controls.
capabilities.notes: Basic transform editing foundation is validated.

capabilities.name: Precision transforms and snapping
capabilities.description: Support numeric input, pivots, transform orientations, snapping, units, guides, workplanes, rulers, and dimensions.
capabilities.notes: Transforms and units exist, but the complete precision-design workflow does not.

capabilities.name: Geometry primitives and scene objects
capabilities.description: Create primitives, curves, paths, text, cameras, lights, and references.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.6.2 — Geometry creation and mesh editing
capabilities.notes: Primitive objects exist; the broader object creation set remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Core mesh editing
capabilities.description: Provide extrude, inset, bevel, cuts, subdivision, merge, fill, bridge, dissolve, smoothing, normals, and cleanup tools.
capabilities.notes: Mesh editing remains outside the current engine foundation.

capabilities.name: Modifier and boolean stack
capabilities.description: Provide ordered nondestructive modifiers, booleans, solidify, warnings, application, removal, and copying.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.6.3 — Modifiers booleans hierarchy and assets

capabilities.name: Scene hierarchy and collections
capabilities.description: Organize objects through collections, parenting, hierarchy, metadata, and reusable scene assets.
capabilities.notes: Scene representation exists; complete collection and asset hierarchy workflows remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Reusable modeling assets
capabilities.description: Support reusable assets, thumbnails, linked and embedded states, dependencies, and repair.

capabilities.name: Materials and textures
capabilities.description: Provide PBR materials, material slots, core node materials, and managed texture channels.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.6.4 — Materials textures UV lighting cameras and rendering

capabilities.name: UV editing
capabilities.description: Generate and edit UVs, seams, packing, inspection, and UV export.

capabilities.name: Lighting cameras and rendering
capabilities.description: Create lighting environments and cameras and produce still or animated renders through managed render jobs.

capabilities.name: Asset animation
capabilities.description: Animate model properties through keyframes, timeline, dope sheet, and curve access.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.6.5 — Animation rig basics physics analysis and print prep

capabilities.name: Model physics setup
capabilities.description: Configure physics bodies, colliders, simulation properties, and basic simulation controls.
capabilities.notes: Shared physics/simulation foundations exist elsewhere in the suite, but the complete Modeler workflow is not wired.

capabilities.name: Geometry analysis and print preparation
capabilities.description: Provide measurements, topology checks, game checks, 3D-print validation, and repair.

capabilities.name: 3D interchange
capabilities.description: Import and export OBJ, STL, GLTF, GLB, PLY, practical FBX, images, SVG, and native assets with conversion options.
capabilities.notes: The original Modeling v0 explicitly had no export pipeline.

capabilities.name: Cross-slice modeling workflows
capabilities.description: Exchange models, reports, BOM data, shaders, animation assets, and game-ready assets with other slices.

capabilities.name: AI modeling proposals
capabilities.description: Allow project-aware AI to propose reviewable and undoable modeling actions.

capabilities.name: Model history autosave and recovery
capabilities.description: Provide undo history, autosave, snapshots, crash recovery, and missing-asset recovery.
